北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风力 4级，体感 20℃，外出注意添衣保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing feels 20℃ with moderate winds. Dress warmly when heading out!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪小雨，体感 29℃ 较闷热，出门记得带伞，注意防潮哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has light rain, feels stuffy at 29℃. Don't forget your umbrella and stay cool.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海 30℃，体感 32℃ 略热，记得多补充水分，注意防晒！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is 30℃, feels 32℃. Stay hydrated and protect yourself from the sun!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州 36℃，体感 38℃ 高温，请务必防暑降温，注意身体！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is scorching at 36℃, feels 38℃. Stay cool and take care in the heat!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴热 32℃，紫外线强，别忘了防晒，多喝水哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and hot at 32℃. Remember sunscreen and stay hydrated!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州体感 29℃，湿度大，感觉有点闷热，保持室内通风哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou feels 29℃ with high humidity. Stay cool and keep your home ventilated.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京 33℃，体感炎热。外出记得防晒，多喝水，防止中暑。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is hot at 33℃. Wear sunscreen, drink water, and prevent heatstroke.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都 31℃，体感 32℃ 略热，请多补充水分，注意休息。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is 31℃, feels 32℃. Stay hydrated and get plenty of rest.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉体感 36℃，非常炎热，请务必防暑，减少户外活动。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan feels 36℃, extremely hot. Stay indoors and avoid heatstroke.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安 34℃，天气炎热干燥，记得多喝水，注意保湿哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is hot and dry at 34℃. Stay hydrated and moisturize.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆 33℃，体感 35℃，炎热闷热，注意防暑降温，多喝水。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is 33℃, feels 35℃, hot and humid. Stay cool and hydrated.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 13℃，风力 4级，有点凉意，出门别忘了添衣哦。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels 13℃ with strong winds. Remember to dress warmly when going out!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳体感 16℃，风力 4级，出门注意防风保暖，小心着凉。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang feels 16℃ with strong winds. Dress warmly to protect yourself from the wind.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明体感 21℃，多云凉爽，是很适合户外活动的好天气呢。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming feels 21℃, cloudy and cool. Perfect weather for outdoor activities!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门 30℃，湿度 72%，风力 4级。体感闷热，注意防暑防潮。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is 30℃ with high humidity and strong winds. It feels muggy, stay cool.
厦门.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛风力 5级，体感 22℃。海边风大，注意防风保暖哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is 22℃ with strong winds. Enjoy the sunshine, but mind the strong winds by the sea!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连体感 17℃，风力 5级。天气晴朗但风大，记得防风添衣哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian feels 17℃ with strong winds. It's sunny but windy, so dress warmly!
